name: Forest-green salad
summary: Nộm rau rừng is the forest-green salad Bao Son La names at bản Vặt. The winter handbook names the same salad in the Thai set. A dressing was not printed. It is kept apart from the Ban Ang forest-vegetable dishes. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: Bản Vặt, xã Mường Sang, in Bao Son La, 17 February 2023. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s winter handbook lists nộm rau rừng with the Thai dishes.
howToEat: Order the salad with the bản Vặt meal. Bao Son La names cơm lam, cá nướng, and gà nướng beside it. A dressing is Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Vặt, xã Mường Sang, on the 17 February 2023 article. The houses there cook it. No house is a pick.
